name: lib-server
description: HTTP kernel for Node.js services: a listener with graceful shutdown, a step pipeline, static file serving with compression and conditional requests, and ordered header rules.

compatibility.note: Support is per entry point: the root entry is the HTTP kernel and is Node-only, and `/policy` imports no Node.js built-in, so it also runs in a browser or a web worker once a bundler includes it. The package publishes no browser bundle of its own.
